apps.description: Open, edit and save text files, with undo, find and replace.

apps.description: A desktop calculator built with easyui.

apps.description: An analogue clock driven by the kernel’s real-time clock.

apps.description: Draw with the mouse: palette, brush sizes on the wheel, C clears.

apps.description: Plays .vid videos, decoded on the CPU.

apps.description: The classic, with the arrow keys.
